raw_sections.experience:
EXPERIENCE
Morgan stanley Aug 2026 -Present Associate 2 Managed trade prematching and affirmation to ensure smooth and timely settlement of securities transactions. Analyzed daily financial transactions, ensuring accurate settlements and compliance with internal policies and controls. Performed position borrowing, realignment, and stock reconciliation with custodians and back- office applications.
Resolved trade discrepancies, short positions, and settlement exceptions by collaborating with cross-functional teams. Handled settlement queries and first-level escalations within defined timelines while performing control checks and delivering quality client service.
Broadridge - Bangalore, Karnataka Process Lead – Operations
Aug 2024 - July 2026 Team Clearing & Settlement DTCC Market (Equities/Bonds) Settlement of Trades, Buy-ins, New Issues, Commercial Paper Buy-ins –Issue notice, create CNS order, retransmit, extend in DTCC Smart Track Manage Buy-in issues and issue CNS and Non-CNS notices and retransmittals, ensuring timely coordination with counterparties and the Middle Office to maintain coverage and resolve discrepancies. Settlements – Prematching, Affirmation of trade to ensure smooth settlement Analyzed daily financial transactions to ensure accurate trade settlements and adherence to internal compliance policies Borrowing and realigning positions on risk trades to ensure settlements; performing stock reconciliation with custodian and back office applications. Collaborated with cross-functional teams to resolve trade discrepancies/ short position and streamline operational workflows for greater efficiency. Ensuring that all queries, first level escalations related to settlement activities are responded to in the time frame specified. Performing control checks for most of the activities to avoid any escalations. Delivering high quality service for client satisfaction. Breaks/ Reconciliation- Researching breaks for COD/COR trades and resolving it on timely basis to avoid aged breaks. NEW ISSUES - Set up new issue cusip’s and documents in DTC UW Source. Working with DTC agent to make the cusip eligible for settlement. Resolve all the issues for smooth settlement. Commercial Papers - Verify booking details of high-value commercial paper trades with Middle Office and Front Office and agent; provide hourly settlement status updates to internal teams and external counterparties. Classification : Internal
Senior Associate – Operations Societe Generale – Accenture- Bangalore, Karnataka Mar 2023 - Aug 2024 Team – ISL Paris & CAD Settlement. FED Market Bonds. Trade settlement for CAD , MEX & Paris market for equities and FED for Bonds. Pre matching, Management report, Stock movement, Re-conciliation, Control checks, Position monitor, SSI setup, Buy-in-issues, Funding. Monitoring and tracking securities transactions, fund transfers and real trade Settlements. Obtaining affirmation and confirmation for all equity trades via emails and phone calls from external counterparties. Co-ordinating & performing all facts related to securities lending- borrowing and settlements. Conducting transaction monitoring, follow-up on end to end process managing until settlement. Interacting & collaborating with front office, custodians, clearing agent to resolve queries raised by clients.
Assisting in settling on all fails due to discrepancies and other mismatches and shorts. Ensuring that all queries, first level escalations related to settlement activities are responded to in the time frame specified. Borrowing and realigning positions on risk trades to ensure settlements; performing stock reconciliation with custodian and back office applications. Handle Buy-in issues and informing Stock Loan team & trade support team to book the short cover to avoid buy-in. Administered exception trades that don't flow through Straight Through Process. Performing control checks for most of the activities to avoid any escalations. Delivering high quality service for client satisfaction. Processed all FED securities, funding and wire settlements. Assisted agents and custodian in resolving delivery problems. Checking recorded transactions are flowing correctly in appropriate systems facilitating successful settlement . Associate – Operations BNP Paribas India Solutions Pvt. Ltd. - Bangalore, Karnataka May 2021 to March 2023 Team –SLAB (Securities Lending & Borrowing) CAD & Mexican Equities Settlement & International Collateral Settlement Prepays, trade settlements, Collateral, re-conciliation.
Management of transactions/trade between BNP & external counterparties. Ensuring all trades instructions are settled/cancelled and fix any breaks between BNP & custodian. Setting up new Standard Settlement Instruction (SSI’s) for payment processing. Agrees daily cash collateral, coordinates instructions to deliver/receive cash with counterparties and reconciles daily cash movements.  Communicating and coordinating with trade desk, counterparties to remediate issues. Successfully completed the migration of Deutsche Bank & Credit Suisse with efficiency. Classification : Internal
